name: targets_130mph_350yd_and_loft
built_for: Orchestrator request (for Mason); Trainer reward shaping
honesty: PUBLIC sources only; no Instagram-derived or Mason-clip data; no video used.
Mason's 120+ mph is self-reported and unverified; nothing here measures him.
TrackMan optimizer chart ends at 120 mph; all 130 mph TrackMan-style points are extrapolations (see launch_targets_120_132_limits.json).
No published TrackMan-type PGA-average-style source exists for a 130 mph club speed with total distance; totals at 130 are Foresight windows (interpolated) or model.
Model rows = repo env/ball_flight_analytic.py (read-only), not a source. Its spin is physically unreliable below ~8 deg spin loft (backspin collapses to ~0/negative at SL<=6): ignore those rows.

foresight_window_130.basis: interpolated between published Foresight 124 and 131 mph rows; ball 190 at 131 mph is published (smash 1.45)

target_130_mph.requirement_for_350_total: Model K=5.6/e=0.845: 345 at AoA 0 (SL 10), 352-356 at AoA +4 (SL 8-10); K=4.0: 340-349. Needs Foresight-window-like delivery (ball ~190+, launch 10-14, spin <= ~2600, spin loft ~8-10 with AoA >= +3) OR ~134+ mph club speed at AoA 0 in the model. At AoA 0 and 130 mph the model and the extrapolated TrackMan row give ~336-340 total, i.e. 350 total is ~3% beyond AoA-0 optimum.
target_130_mph.requirement_for_350_carry: Not reached at 130 mph by the model (max carry ~324) or by the extrapolated TrackMan row (326); inside the Foresight window upper half (342-372, unverified as achievable for a real player). Published real evidence of 350+ carry is at 145 mph (WLD). Treat 350 carry at 130 mph as a stretch with all of: smash >=1.49, AoA >= +4, spin loft <= 8-9, spin ~2000-2400.

published: spin loft ~= dynamic loft - AoA (TrackMan; 3-D angle, path/face-angle terms small)
launch ~= AoA + f*spin_loft, f = 0.96-0.0071*SL (Tutelman 3-D launch page, fetched) i.e. dynamic loft sets launch more than AoA (TrackMan 10 Fundamentals)
spin set mainly by spin loft and club speed (TrackMan); smash falls with spin loft: model/Tutelman ~ (1+e)/(1+m/M)*cos(SL)
tour driver: dyn loft 12.8, AoA -0.9, spin 2545-2686, launch 10.4-10.9, smash 1.48-1.49 (TrackMan/Pebble snippet)
driver strike location: 10 mm low = ~2 deg less dynamic loft (face roll)
shaft bend adds loft: ~2 deg stiff to ~5 deg flexible (Tutelman, unverified snippet)
derived_here: Per 1 deg AoA at fixed dynamic loft: launch +1 deg, spin loft -1 deg (spin -~280 rpm in the model at 130 mph).
Model slope: backspin ~280 rpm per deg spin loft at 130 mph (K=4.0); repo impact doc said ~316 at K=3.5.

Launch 8-10 deg at AoA 0 needs spin loft ~9-11 (Tutelman relation; see launch_from_aoa_and_spin_loft); with K=4.0 that gives spin 2400-3000 and total ~330-338 (model); with the repo-recommended K=5.6 it gives spin ~1800-2200, carry ~316, total ~345 (model).

To reach 350 total at 130 mph the model needs spin loft ~8-10 AND AoA ~+4 (K=5.6: total 352-356, launch 11-12.8, spin 1600-2000, carry 324-325; K=4.0: 340-349). So launch ends up ~11-13 deg, NOT 8-10: low launch (8-10) with AoA>=+4 means spin loft 4-7 where the model spin is unphysical (<=~1100 rpm; real balls rarely below ~1500) -- unverified region.
env_wrist_implications: Env wrist: w=0 is a 90 deg L (club along -z, forearm +x), w>0 more cocked. Contact target w ~ 0.173 - 0.564*elbow_rad (+-0.1) is from the repo's earlier analysis (not re-derived here).

Less cocked / more released wrist at contact -> shaft closer to vertical in the swing plane -> LESS hand-ahead lean; more cocked = more forward shaft lean (hands ahead) = less dynamic loft. For a driver the target is NOT large forward lean: published coaching sources say neutral/slightly behind (unverified snippets) because AoA must be positive.

Env loft is set by loft_deg (head box rotation about y, env/humanoid_golf_env.py line ~120): static head loft; dynamic loft in the env = static loft +/- shaft-angle effects, NOT verified here. To log dynamic loft/spin loft per shot the env needs club-face normal and club velocity at contact (not exposed to me).

Practical knob order: (1) choose static loft_deg ~ 8-9 (published driver range 8-12), (2) get AoA +2..+5 from sequencing/ball position (hand path), (3) keep wrist near the w_contact band, (4) verify measured launch/spin vs table before touching rewards.
Wrist dynamic lag (0.06 s command lead) shifts effective w at impact by tens of degrees: lag, not sign error (earlier repo finding) -- re-check dynamic loft after the lead fix.
reward_suggestions: Penalise spin_loft outside 7-11 deg and launch outside 8-14 deg (derived, gate-style), not dynamic loft alone.
Reward AoA in [+2,+6] for driver only; hard-fail smash>1.50 (existing gate).

sources.note: TrackMan optimizer rows to 120 mph (see launch_targets_120_132_limits.json). 120 mph AoA 0: ball 178, 9.3 deg, 2890 rpm, carry 296, total 340.
Optimized driver windows: 131 mph club: ball 190, launch 10-14, spin 2600-1600, carry 342-372, total 378-401 (vendor window, not a point; ball 190 = smash 1.45).
WLD men avg 145 mph club, 214 ball, smash 1.48, launch 11.2, spin 2789, carry 352 yd (first published carry >=350 evidence; at 145 not 130 mph).
Single practice shot 141.3 mph, AoA ~+8, spin 1850, 409 yd total. Existence proof only.

Launch = AoA + SL*(0.96-0.0071*SL); ball speed = Vc*(1+e)/(1+m/M)*cos(SL); his 'dynamic loft' there = spin loft; spin 160*Vc*sin(SL) is a 2007 rule that over-predicts for modern balls (repo impact doc: do not use). He compared against TrackMan live in 2011, 'very consistent'.

AoA: PGA Tour driver -0.9, LPGA +2.8, male amateurs scratch -0.9/5 HCP -1.1/10 HCP -1.2; 'hitting up on the ball (positive AoA) is a must' for max driver distance; standard TrackMan assumption AoA 0 for driver.

Spin loft = 3-D angle between club-head motion (AoA, path) and face orientation (dynamic loft, face angle) ~= dynamic loft - AoA; spin rate primarily from spin loft and club speed; optimizer driver 94 mph AoA 0 -> spin loft 15.

Dynamic loft affected by AoA, shaft bend, release, face-to-path, impact location (high-face hit = more dynamic loft); optimizer driver 94 mph / AoA 0 -> dyn loft 15.6; 'dynamic loft has a greater impact than AoA on launch angle' (TrackMan 10 Fundamentals).
10 mm low strike on a driver = ~2 deg less dynamic loft at impact location (face roll); for driver spin loft 10-15 the AoA becomes 4-6 deg steeper at ball separation than at first touch.

PGA Tour TrackMan dynamic loft driver 12.8 deg (LPGA 15.5); no published tour shaft-lean average; lead-wrist flexion at contact ~20 deg with driver in 12 female pros (Zhang et al., Qualisys 250 Hz); shaft lean as read from a video is camera dependent.
Shaft bends forward/toe-down at impact: flexible shaft adds up to ~5 deg of loft, stiff ~2 deg.
Simulation: dynamic loft changes up to 0.65 deg with shaft stiffness at ~101 mph (4.82 vs 5.47 deg).
Delivered loft change with shaft flex is predicted by butt-ahead-of-ball (ButtX) and grip twist about the shaft axis (r=.867 for grip twist), i.e. hands/forward lean alone do not set loft.
Carry-optimal launch vs ball speed at AoA 0: 175 mph -> 8.5 deg, 190 mph -> 7 deg; dynamic loft includes shaft bend, face roll, cupped/bowed lead wrist.
PGA Tour driver 113 mph/167/1.48/10.9/2686 rpm/275 yd carry.

unverified_items: Total distance at 130 mph as a point (none published).
Foresight 130 mph window values are interpolated and vendor-theoretical.
WLD 145 mph averages and Burke shot (search snippets).
Per-degree shaft-lean-to-dynamic-loft conversion (none published for driver).
Shaft-bend loft 2-5 deg and TrackMan pages quoted via search snippets.
Model spin below spin loft ~8 deg (unphysical); model carry runs ~5% below the extrapolated TrackMan row.
